The README states that every S* equals the register's reported value at main 4e8c898 (to 1e-14; at 207 to 2.4e-12) and that at 153 and 207 a re-run on the register's witnesses gives the same p, with 207's witness point not verified on pair (73, 74), so 207's committed form is from a copy that ties it (store id 1044231).
The issue says each p is irreducible; no program under search/exact/cur/ or verify_exact.py checks irreducibility.
